subject: general
question: As per information received till November 2020, who is the Chairman of Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shiv Das Meena**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of November 2020, **Shiv Das Meena**, an IAS officer, was serving as the Chairman of the **Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB)**.
 
• He **was appointed to this position in August 2020**.
 
• CPCB is a** statutory organizatio**n under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, responsible for monitoring and controlling pollution in India.
 
• **Shiv Das Meena is a 1989 batch IAS officer known for holding several administrative roles in various capacities across India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) is a statutory organization constituted in September 1974 under the Water Prevention and Control of Pollution Act, 1974.
 
• Further, CPCB was entrusted with the powers and functions under the Air Prevention and Control of Pollution Act, 1981. 
 
• The Central Pollution Control Board is led by its chairman; this chairman is appointed by the Central Government. 
 
• This entire board comes under Central Government.
 
• According to Section-3, the Central Pollution Control Board can have a maximum of five officials nominated by the Central Government and not more than five persons nominated by the Central Government from amongst the members of State Boards.
 
• The Central Pollution Control Board is the apex organization in the country in the field of pollution control. It is a technical wing of the Ministry of Environment and Forest. It comes under the Government of India.
